records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Star Guard. Generate ONE complete Storm Coast Tempest Leviathan second transformed boss vessel, not a sheet. Reference image is the EXISTING boss atlas for material/rendering continuity; take only the matching teal salvage steel, rust orange turbines, chains boss as identity reference. New physical configuration: unfolded wide flood-control wings with hollow drainage channels and swept lateral sponsons; expanded command spine, visibly different broad manta silhouette. Genuine complex polished prerendered arcade spacecraft/organic game art. Directly overhead orthographic view, front towards bottom, approximately 1.8:1 wide silhouette. Full body centered with at least 15 percent transparent padding on ALL sides, every appendage fully visible. Actual transparent background; no ground, frame, text, external cast shadow, HUD or detached debris. Make the transformation a new finished coherent silhouette, not recolouring or scaling. The vessel is a supporting hull with recessed dark attachment sockets, no separate bright floating turrets; destructible modules are added in game. Preserve dark hull details and sharp alpha edges.

New anatomy: larger four-way split jaws, two curved ivory tusks, thicker layered chitin collar. Direct overhead orthographic game sprite, forward end UP. Complex polished prerendered arcade creature illustration, no spacecraft or heart. Entire appendages visible, centered with generous 18 percent transparent padding all sides. Actual transparent background. No text, square border, floor, outer shadow, detached pieces. Designed to connect to neighbouring moving segments. Strong complete silhouette, intact dark tissue detail. Anatomically more complex and imposing than the original head, not just a recolour or scaled copy.
